project.title: Ethylene glycol metabolism in Propionibacterium freudenreichii
project.projectDescription: This study was performed to monitor ethylene glycol metabolism by Propionibacterium freudenreichii and to elucidate the metabolic pathway involved.
project.sampleProcessingProtocol: P. freudenreichii cells grown for 7 days on ethylene glycol (50 mM) or lactate (50 mM) were harvested by centrifugation of 1 mL of sample at 17,000 × g for 1 and cell pellets were frozen at -80 degrees. Samples were washed twice with 100 mM Tris (pH 8) and resuspended in 100 μl 100 mM Tris. Samples were lysed by sonication for 45 s twice while cooling 1 min on ice. Protein content was determined using Pierce Coomassie protein assay and samples were diluted to 0.5 μg/μl using Tris–HCl pH 8. Samples were reduced (15 mM DTT), alkylated (20 mM acrylamide) and digested (0.5 ug sequencing grade trypsin) according to the filter assisted sample preparation protocol (FASP).
project.dataProcessingProtocol: MaxQuant (2.0.3.0) with Andromeda search engine was used for identification and relative quantitation.

quantificationMethods.name: MS1 intensity based label-free quantification method
